name: Wire lever-connector line
product: Three wires (red, white, black) cut to length against a ruler, laid in color order (red top, white middle, black bottom) and closed in a 3-port lever connector. A second lever connector joins the other end of the red wire to a separate black wire. QA is a pull test: no wire may come out of either connector.

failReasons.label: Wire pulled out of connector 1 (the 3-wire connector)
Wire pulled out of connector 2 (red to black)

stations.label: Cut
stations.output: one wire cut to length per cycle (three cycles per unit: red, white, black)
stations.note: One cycle is one wire. The operator cuts and checks the red, white and black wire in turn, so a unit is three S1 cycles.

substeps.label: Check for correct length against the ruler

stations.label: Arrange and clamp
stations.output: the three wires closed in lever connector 1, red top, white middle, black bottom

substeps.label: Arrange the wires: red top, white middle, black bottom
Close the levers on the wires

stations.label: Second connector
stations.output: a second lever connector joining the other end of the red wire to a black wire

substeps.label: Add a new lever connector to the other end of the red wire
Insert the black wire into the new connector

stations.label: QA pull test
stations.output: one tested unit, pass or fail
stations.note: The cameras see the pull test; the result comes from the P or F key. S4's cycle count comes from those presses.

substeps.label: Pull test: no wire comes out of either connector
Pass or fail (P or F key)
substeps.note: No camera rule: the answer-key keeper presses P or F.
